title: Fix Mirrored Panel Growth
description: Fix Panel/Pane window-chrome so right-to-left and bottom-to-top growth keep a correct U-cutout silhouette and cap docking.
summary: Fixed mirrored panel/pane growth for RTL (top-right, bottom-right) and bottom-up anchors by making WindowChrome cap-dock aware and rewriting measureWindowSilhouetteMetrics to read painted chip spans by data-dock instead of assuming LTR top caps. Panel/Pane pass capDock from flow.block; added vitest coverage for RTL metrics, bottom-dock metrics, and bottom-anchored panel wiring.
